title: searchBox upgrade
body:
- should have good behavior by default: http://shipow.github.io/searchbox/
- container: should be possible to use a `<div>` container: we create the whole markup
- should be possible to bind an existing `<input>`
- should be possible to link to a wrapping `<form>` so that we listen for `submit` and `reset` events
- remove searchOnlyOnEnterKey
- add searchAsYouType
- remove poweredBy, poweredBy is a simple link below the input, there's no need to have it by default in the widget
- should embed default shortcuts to focus: ['s', '/']

previous discussion #859
